summary: Fyers refuses the 50-level (TBT) socket from the start: a 50-level Depth subscribe is taken on the HSM depth feed and served its five levels (audit P-10).

notes: fyers_websocket_adapter.py:373-381: TBT unavailable, falling back to 5-level depth.

deviations.reason: Fyers refused the 50-level socket, so the 50-level Depth subscription is served on the HSM depth feed's five levels at once (lead decision on the deep book); the web's oracle cannot model the refused TBT socket and publishes nothing for this packet (its adapter falls back to 5-level depth, fyers_websocket_adapter.py:373-381).
